comment: Display-only pose of the Support3D.glb CAD origin in tool0 (ROS axes, meters/radians). The CAD origin is the phone/screen center; the robot-side face is about +0.1595 m on CAD X, with CAD +X pointing back to the flange. In the URDF tool0 used by the viewer, the real support exits along -Z. The metrology-grade T_tool0_mire is co-solved by hand-eye calibration.
